description:
Jocelyn Tyson, from District 38, Region 7, won with a speech titled, "Have You Been There?" 

To learn more about the World Championship of Public Speaking(R) visit https://www.toastmasters.org/events/2023-international-convention/world-championship-of-public-speaking.
